name: kaiki/booking-wordpress
description: The Kaiki booking plugin for WordPress. A thin client of the Kaiki public API.

scripts-descriptions.lint: phpcs against the WordPress ruleset and the PHP 8.1 compatibility ruleset (WPP-11). What CI runs.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: phpcbf, which fixes what it can of the above.
scripts-descriptions.test: The plugin's own unit tests: the webhook signature, the cache key and the locale order. The rest of the plugin is tested by the Playwright run against a real WordPress site (WPP-15).
